# ToolMate Resume Builder (https://resume.toolmate.co.in)

> ToolMate Resume Builder is a free, privacy-first, professional ATS resume builder and career preparation platform. It operates 100% locally in the browser with zero login required, offering real-time vector PDF export, native Word (.docx) export, 18+ ATS-friendly templates, and an interactive AI interview prep generator.

## Core Features
- **100% Client-Side Privacy**: All data is stored in the user's browser (IndexedDB / LocalStorage). No resume data or personal information is sent to backend servers.
- **ATS Compliance**: Semantic structure, standard headings, and single/two-column layouts engineered to pass 99%+ Applicant Tracking Systems (Workday, Greenhouse, Lever, Taleo, iCIMS).
- **Multi-Format Export**:
  - **Vector A4 PDF**: Client-side pixel-perfect vector PDF generation without browser print dialog dependencies.
  - **Editable Word (.docx)**: Native Microsoft Word document export replicating template layouts, colors, and typography while remaining fully editable.
  - **JSON Resume**: Standard JSON Resume schema backup and restore.
- **18+ Curated Templates**:
  - Tech & Developer templates (Monospace, timeline, high information density)
  - Designer templates (Creative accents, typography-led)
  - Executive & Corporate templates (Classic Serif, formal headers, academic LaTeX styles)
- **Built-in Career Tools**:
  - **Job Description Matcher**: Real-time keyword gap analysis against target job postings.
  - **AI Interview Prep**: Skill-based interview question generator with structured STAR-method answers and runnable code explanations (/interview-prep).
  - **Smart Importers**: PDF resume text extraction and LinkedIn export importer.
  - **Action Verb Thesaurus**: One-click weak verb replacement with high-impact power verbs.
